authorization.statement: Owner-provided code equivalent to 'I AGREE TO ALLOW CLAWSEC TO PERFORM A FULL-SCOPED VULNERABILITY ASSESSMENT ON MY COMPANY AND MY ASSETS.' was returned by the main public-facing website.

constraints: No destructive actions (DDoS, malware, phishing, credential stuffing, brute force, MFA bypass, lateral movement, stealth evasion).
No third-party impact; cloud/CDN infrastructure that is not owner-controlled is out of scope.
No data exfiltration or persistence; proof-of-concept only.
Scope is limited to assets confirmed via the enumeration phase and approved by the owner.
